errors.evidence: The description states there are five regions, but the chart shows six regions on the x-axis (Северозападен, Северен, Североизточен, Югоизточен, Югозападен, Южен).

The description identifies the minimum total railway network length as 782 km in the Southern region. However, the chart shows the minimum value for the grey bars (total length) is 484 km in the Northeastern (Североизточен) region.

errors.text_span: най-дългите двойни линии са в Северозападния регион (192 км)
errors.evidence: The description claims the longest double lines are 192 km in the Northwestern region. The chart data shows the highest value for double lines (blue bars) is 244 km in the Northeastern (Североизточен) region.
The description states the shortest double lines are 116 km in the Southern region. According to the chart, the shortest double lines (blue bars) are 89 km in the Northern (Северен) region.

The description claims the shortest electrified lines (оранжеви стълбове) are 89 km in the Northern region. The value 89 km in the Northern region corresponds to the double lines (сини стълбове), not the electrified lines. The shortest electrified line is actually 369 km in the Northeastern region.
